title: Personal VM Guest Enrollment
description: New personal-guest/v1 protocol; never sent to Docker v1 or a Network Control enrollment route. A guest-specific mTLS certificate and a short one-time challenge in Authorization are required. Core derives assistant, owner, VM generation, data identity, policy and binding from the pending registration. Atomic one-time challenge consumption and current owner/access checks are server duties. This request grants registration and heartbeat only; no Docker/PVE/SSH/network management or task execution rights. POST /api/personal-guest/v1/bindings/{bindingId}/enroll returns 201 with the binding. Authorization is exactly Bearer followed by a canonical, unpadded base64url 32-byte crypto/rand challenge (43 characters), issued for 60–600 seconds and pinned to the binding plus certificate fingerprint; only its SHA256 hash is persisted. A consumed challenge cannot be replayed: 401. After a lost response, GET the same binding with the pinned certificate; this does not issue new authority. Missing/wrong certificate, challenge, enrollment or expired registration: 401; current owner/access, superseded binding or policy rejection: 403. Reject duplicate JSON keys and noncanonical field casing; no credential is accepted in a query or forwarded header.
